## Copy-Edit Log — Analysis-of-Variance

Tracks copy-editing passes over this module's `.qmd` documents. Clear-cut
typos/grammar/spelling errors are corrected directly in the source. Items
that need an author decision (ambiguous phrasing, possible content errors,
incomplete sentences) are left in place but wrapped in `<mark>...</mark>`
so they show up highlighted in the rendered HTML — search the rendered
page or the source for `<mark>` to find them. Line numbers below refer to
`narrative.qmd` as of this pass.
